asset.name: Inspection failed
asset.description: Sent to the site manager when a monthly inspection fails.
asset.subject: Safety inspection failed at {{site_name}} ({{period}})
asset.html_body:
Safety inspection failed: {{site_name}}

Hi {{site_manager}},

This month's safety inspection of {{site_name}} failed {{failed_count}} check(s).

Findings: {{task_data.findings}}

A corrective action is due by {{action_due}}. Please make sure it is done; the inspector will record it once complete.

Sent by the safety inspection checklist
